## JAMBO'S PANEL BESIDE THE LISTS (lane A1 of the redesign gaps, 18 Oct 2026)

The owner said "build all the gaps" against the picked drawings. Lane A1 covered: one shared Jambo panel beside every list (rounds 14, 15, 19 and the panel rules of rounds 3–26), the hint line under every Jambo ask box, Negotiations round 14 option 1, Approvals & signing round 15 option 1, and People round 19 scene b.

WHAT WAS THERE. The list inspector (#ins-panel) was a plain facts panel ~520px wide with the 27 Sep "needs you" checklist as a band under the name; Approvals had a white band under its title carrying the counts; the Jambo window floated over list pages; no Jambo box had the hint line; a rule step's question on the one ask list was opened with `stamp: null`, so "Since last look" could not be read.

WHAT WAS BUILT. jlFrame dresses #ins-panel once (so a row press never wipes what is typed): Jambo's tab, the page's word, ‹ Jambo, the fold; Home's panel width 380, folded 46; the page beside it is narrowed by :has() margins that ignore a panel inside a hidden tab (the Templates book tab was going blank until this). insFits measures the page and the panel together (jlReserved) so the panel never takes itself away. The checklist became the "Needs you" section; the page's own owed work (e.g. "Answer 2 redlines") leads and yields to the checklist's ruby "quiet" row so nothing is said twice. Nothing chosen, Jambo says the page from the page's own counts with no AI call; the chips are the page's own doors. The ask follows the Counter's reading (place → held contract → Jambo's map → a question), and a question is one turn of the one conversation, said in the panel; the window's feed is emptied while the panel shows it (a chart's canvas id is never drawn twice) and no badge lights for an answer the reader is looking at. The bar's Jambo door beside a list goes to the panel's box; the old window check moved to the Brain page.

SINCE LAST LOOK. The server now stamps a rule step's question with srvApprovalStamp of the saved record when the save makes the step due; a stamp sent in the body is replaced (f734 2a forges one). The browser's reopen and resubmit pass approvalStamp(c). apSinceLook compares that stamp with the record: same / wording / value / terms / unknown (a question asked before the stamp existed says so; a masked value is not read as a moved one).

MEASUREMENTS. Approvals at 1440 with the panel: Kind needed 97px ("Signature" pill), Whose turn 178 ("Jonas signs · back Friday"), Waiting 117 ("100 days · late"); the columns were 92/168/104 and cut. Re-set to 76/100/190/188/120/88; party column 264 at 1440, 190 at 1366 (one-worklist asks ≥170). Settings' side panel is measured on arrival and again 420ms later (stSideFit); a reading in between found its foot 34px low — the check now waits for the settled state, bounded. Home's hint with keys wrapped "Esc / closes" at 1536; the keys became one nowrap unit.

CENSUS. ink-wash and theme-tokens are green at 8dc306a and moved here; audited as a set difference: no new palette colour (Templates gains Home's panel dressing — rgba(43,43,45,.35) shadow, accent-100, a token colour-mix, a .16 shadow; ink-wash only counts rise). Not re-recorded.

RED AT THE PARENT. f730 0/17, f731 0/8, f732 0/11, f733 0/16, f734 0/6, f735 0/16, f736 0/12; jambos-list-panel-verify 36 failed at base, every driven part guarded (6s default wait) so a missing control reports.

DECISIONS. Kept the panel's doors and ⋯ though the drawing shows fewer; "Show their contracts" (not "his"); Away is shown only where the reader may know it (their own, or one they stand in for — the server sends no other); the Approvals band went because the drawing puts its counts on the title's line; the hint stays on the four boxes the spec named.

BUILDING ROUNDS 17, 3 AND 6 AS DRAWN (lane B2, 18 Oct 2026; the owner's "build all the gaps")

What the drawings asked for, and what HaTi did not do yet. Round 17 ("Then and now") drew the Board with one head card: Board, what it is, Live and the time it was counted, Summarise with its cost, Make a pack, and saved views as chips with counts. Below it came Your book as a card whose rows say what they count, then Today's insights with its count and month. Jambo's panel beside the Board had two bubbles and its own chips. The Needs you card and the Jambo's work card were gone from the Board, because the Counter now carries them. Round 3 ("Tabs and faces") drew Needs you here with a private note of yours due on the contract, and their redlines naming their clauses. Round 6 ("One line") drew the glance with the round in its pill, their round, each of their asks in its own words with Go to it, a "nobody named to sign" row, and a risks row. It also drew chips that put what you owe first, and Follow me working on Home's paper. Before this change, Follow me read and moved only the Negotiate page, so on Home it neither said where the reader was nor moved anyone.

How it was built. Every new row reads an existing fact. The note row is My notes' own reading (mineNotesDue) narrowed to the contract, and the server answers it only for the person signed in. Each ask is said from its own stored ops. The value line reads fxCounted and guesses no rate. "To decide" reads the renewal window. Follow me got one walk door (presenceGo) and one clause mover for Home's paper (igPaperGoClause), which moves the page and writes nothing. Go to it uses the same mover. The Board's head reads one counted time (hbCountedAt), shared with Jambo's greeting so the two never disagree.

Measured. The new checks were run against the parent 8dc306a. 110 of 116 node tests fail there; the 6 that pass are guards. board-as-drawn-verify has 18 failures there, and paper-panel-as-drawn-verify has 14. The fit check passes at 1440×780, 1536×730 and 1366×950. The panel at 1536×730 first opened scrolled to the bottom of the conversation, so the glance was off screen. The feed now opens at the top when nothing has been said yet.

Found on the way. A first version of the Follow me reading returned nothing when the middle of the screen fell in the gap between two clauses near the end of the paper. It now reads the nearest clause. A re-pointed check passed a node-side selector into the page and measured nothing. Caught, fixed, and the check now passes the selector in. Four older node tests went red during the work and were fixed in the code, not the tests: a variable named "sc" read as a contract field write (f392), the reading had to come first in hbAsk (f520), the pack button's markup is pinned where hbBoardHtml builds it (f658), and the Negotiate flow's first brain step is pinned (f676), so the new part joined the ask flow beside Home's paper instead.

Re-pointed, with reason. 17 browser checks and 8 node tests pinned the Board's Needs you and Jambo's work cards, the three chips, "All N", Answer and the glance's old rows. They were moved to the Counter, the head's chips and the drawn words.

To answer the question: I am building with Claude Code, as one of several helpers working side by side, each on its own part. Mine was the Settings pages, made to match the three designs you picked (rounds 24, 25 and 26).

What is built:
- Your settings: the top line now says the page is yours alone, with "Ask an admin" beside it. Every "Change" opens its small form right inside its own row instead of a side panel.
- People can now change their own name. They can also change their own email, but only with their current password. Neither can touch anyone else's details or their own role.
- "Your data · Download" gives a person one file of everything they are allowed to see. The download is written into the history before the file leaves.
- The page now also shows when your password last changed, who set your role, and how many devices are signed in.
- Company: the top line shows the company name. "You" and "Company" are now underlined tabs, and Company shows how many things need you.
- Jambo describes the page in plain words. The cards, the step-by-step ladder of rules and the "Who holds what" table now match the drawing.
- Jambo's side panel tells you what it is showing and can fold away to the right edge. The Menu now opens when you type "/" in his box.
- Contract streams: pressing a stream shows its details beside the list. That includes what is due to be deleted, what is on legal hold, and a "Delete these" button that asks you once more before deleting.
- Data & backup: the list of past history downloads now shows how many records each one contained. Jambo explains the history download in words.

Everything was checked in a real browser, including a real delete and a real email change, and photographed at your three screen sizes.

Three things in the drawings were not built, because HaTi has no true fact to show:
- a daily brief "at 08:00": the brief has no set hour today;
- a "Named guests only" switch: no such link rule exists yet;
- a clash "since 14 Oct": HaTi does not record when a clash first appeared.

If you want any of these, each would be a small new feature. Tell me which.

Things to know:
- Until now, people could change only their job title, not their name. That old rule is replaced by the "Name · Change" row in the drawing.
- One existing test that said a person could not rename themselves was updated to match. It still checks that nobody can rename someone else.
- A few extra links that are not in the drawings were kept rather than removed without asking, such as "Jambo accuracy" and "Who runs the signing on an upload".
- The colour check counts colours and text sizes on each screen. On the Settings screen those counts changed: no new colour was added, and there is one new text size (the small fold arrow). I did not reset that check's saved counts; that needs your yes.

Nothing outside the Settings pages and their server parts was changed.

## SETTINGS AS DRAWN — THE SECOND PASS (rounds 24, 25 and 26; 18 Oct 2026)

The adversarial checker compared lane F with the owner's picked drawings ("One sheet", "Control room", "The SAP way") and listed 26 differences. This pass built them.

WHAT WAS BROKEN. On arrival at Company, Jambo said "Seven things need you here … and 3 more", while the tag and the Company tab said 6. Further down, the list showed "3 more" when only 2 more rows existed. The cause: stSyncAttention took rows out after the first paint but never fixed the "N more" row or Jambo's words. The "N more" fault was already there at the parent. Now the same function sets the tag, "N more" (the rows the list holds and does not draw) and Jambo's first words and first chip. Measured in a browser: before "Eight … / 7 / 4 more", now "Seven … / 7 / 3 more". On the Backup tab, Jambo said "I am counting the trail" forever, because the count was only fetched on The trail. It is now fetched on either tab, the turning ring shows while it counts, and a failed count is said.

THE OWNER'S ANSWER 12, BUILT. Clashes in who may do what are worked out live in the browser from the gates' own rules. The server now keeps one fact about each: the day it was first seen (POST /api/clashes/seen, admin only, ids and days with no names; a clash that goes away is forgotten). The Settings page sends its clash keys only when the set has changed, after it is painted and after a save, so drawing the page never writes. So "since <day>" means the day an admin's Settings page first saw the clash. A clash that appears while no admin looks gets the day one first does. This is said in notDoneYet rather than hidden.

THE CARDS. The first pass had kept extra doors "rather than removing without asking". The picked drawing is the agreement (commit 8dc306a), so each card now names exactly the drawing's facts and doors. Every panel stays one press away in the Menu beside the board, which lists all 32, each once. f193 and f691 were re-pointed to ask that of the Menu, and of the cards only that they hold company panels and no panel twice among facts or among doors. A fact and a door may open the same drawer where the drawing shows that (Links you send, Going live). Jambo's agents › is his house.

THE FRAME. Sub-pages (Contract streams, Data & backup, Team, Who holds what, Roles) now start at their own name. The window's head is hidden by scope (body:has(#set-page[data-st-sub]) #page-head), never with !important, and the tabs are not drawn. At 1440×780 the stream panel's acts were cut off at y=798. They now sit at the panel's foot while it "scrolls a little", as the drawing allows. Measured with the acts inside the panel at all three screens.

THE PRONOUN. The drawings say "I can send her your question" and "Back to her role". HaTi stores no one's pronoun, so it uses the name ("I can send Sara your question", "Back to Lina's role"). The question went to the owner as blocked.

NOT BUILT, BY THE OWNER'S ANSWERS: "Every morning at 08:00" (answer 10) and "Named guests only" (answer 11).

RE-POINTED, each with its reason in the file: f193, f601, f691, f726, f727, and the browser checks access-review, clashes, company-control-room, settings-groups, settings-tabs, streams-and-data and white-band-and-tabs. white-band-and-tabs was already red at the lane's last commit: it still checked for the 16 Oct pill, which round 25 reversed. The colour census moved on Settings in the first pass. This pass left it unchanged, and it was not re-recorded.

## JAMBO'S WORK AS DRAWN — ROUND 23'S GAPS (18 Oct 2026)

The owner's "build all the gaps" (18 Oct 2026) covered what the 17 Oct build of round 23 ("Open in place") had left out or noted as "kept, and why". Lane G built the Counter as drawn. The word stays "Put away", as the owner chose.

- **ONE ROW PER PIECE, ONE ACT.** The 17 Oct build drew every act the house's panel has (e.g. Read the brief · Open the Overview · Review 2 obligations · Mark as read). The drawing draws Look · its act · Discard. The acts are now data (`agActsOf`). The house's panel draws all of them (`agPanelActs`, byte-identical apart from the new Put away and the new act words). The Counter's row draws ONE act (`agRowActOf`): the panel's lead act, except for a new contract's read while details are still owed, which shows "Fill in N details" as drawn. That act goes to Fill in's one door (`agGo('details')` → `roomOpenAt`). The act words follow the drawing on every surface: "Answer on Redlines" (was "Answer on the negotiation"), "Decide the renewal" (was "Open the renewal"), "Check the N files" (was "Open the import queue"). Each row also has the drawing's short title, reference and one sentence (`agPieceTitle`, `agPieceRefHtml`, `agPieceLine`). These read only the piece's existing readings: no model call, nothing written.
- **PUT AWAY ON EVERY PIECE — REVERSES THE 17 OCT "KEPT, AND WHY".** The 17 Oct note kept Put away off pieces that are someone's owed work. The drawing has it on every piece and the owner said build all. There are two keepers for one press (`agPutAway`). A desk row (notice, renewal, chase) is stamped on the contract by an editor through the desk's one writer (`deskDismiss`); its Undo is `{undo:true}` through the same writer, so the desk still has exactly one persist (f274). Anything else, and anything for a reader who may not edit, is put away for that person only: their prefs `agentAway`, through `agentAwaySet` (js/agentruns.js, still the agents' one door to the server, f413 7d). PUT /api/me/prefs checks it: a piece key (`AGENT_AWAY_KEY`), a subject of up to 400 characters, at most 20 at once, null to remove, the newest `AGENT_AWAY_MAX` (300) kept. The reading (`agAwayHeld`) drops a piece only while it is still about the same thing (`agAwaySubject`: the piece's own ask ids, reading time, chase day and so on), so a new round of theirs brings it back. The work itself is untouched: their asks still wait, the approval still sits in Needs you. Undo shows in the toast for a few seconds, and the house's points log is told "thrown" only after Undo has passed (`AG_AWAY_UNDO_MS`, 6 s), so a piece taken straight back scores nothing.
- **LOOK ON A CHASE IS THE LETTER, AND THE LETTER IS WRITTEN ONCE.** The Counter's Look on a chase now shows only the email and the line "It goes to the address on the contract. You are asked once more before it is sent." (`ag_chase_note` reworded in both books). The house's panel keeps its facts around the same letter. While building it I found that the screen printed the stored "2026-10-13" while the chase route (since 28 Sep) sent "13 October 2026": two copies of one letter had drifted. The letter now lives in js/sharemail.js (`chaseMailOf`), the module CLAUDE.md names for every email sentence. `srvChaseSend` and `agChaseMail` both build from it, and f802 compares the inbox with the screen word for word. As drawn, it is signed by the person who presses, for our company on the agreement (c.party, else the workspace), in place of "This is an automated notice from HaTi CLM." With nobody pressing, the notice stays. The reminder sentence itself is kept as HaTi's, because an obligation's description is free text (the drawing's "Could you send it…" only fits a deliverable). The standing link, which only the server can look up, is the one line the screen leaves out, and the box's hover says so.
- **"ALL SEVEN AGENTS: ASK ME FIRST · SET BY SARA FOR EVERYONE".** Who set a level was not recorded anywhere. PUT /api/agents/:k/settings now stamps `levelBy` (the caller, looked up, never taken from the request) and `levelAt`, only when the level moves; a Save that changes something else names nobody. /api/agents/status gives every member the name (a colleague's name is allowed to travel). `agLevelsSaid` groups the seven agents that act by level, lists who set them and the agents where this person chose their own level. It returns null until the status has loaded, so nothing is guessed. `cnJwLevelsHtml` writes the line. A member's "Ask an admin" opens the tracked ask (`stAskFrom('agents')`: the record, the admin's Needs you and bell), which presses nothing by itself (rule 7b). An admin gets "Change", which opens the agents' settings.
- **THE COUNTER AROUND IT.** Chips as drawn: the first owed row by its short name (`cnNeedShort`), pressing that row's own door, then contracts · calendar · draft a new agreement. The "jambo's work" chip (his row is right below) and the upload chip are not drawn. Jambo's work head when open: "· N prepared · nothing sent or filed until you press". Needs you rows: the title is the task ("Answer an approval for Jonas", "Fill in 2 details"). An approval answered for someone away has the pill "for Jonas · away until Friday" (`approvalAnswersFor`, the approvals' own `approverForOf`/`awayForOf`). The line gives the name, the party unless the title names it (a salary's job title, as the Pay section reads it), the value where an approval or signature turns on it, and "waiting N days". The reference is on hover. Buttons open their page (Open approval, Open redlines, Fill in, Open; a look's button had said "Done" while opening the contract). The list is whole as drawn: a note of yours that is due (`mineNotesDue`) and a request nobody holds (`intakeAlertRows`) are rows, read from the bell's own lists, and the number counts them. "Show N more" names what is hidden. A list that arrives after the first paint is drawn when it comes (`counterFollow`, called from `updateSidebarCounts` and `mineLoad`).
- **A CASCADE FIGHT, WON BY SCOPE.** The row's title line wrapped its reference onto a second line because `.cn-w b{flex-wrap:wrap}` (0,1,1) beat `.cn-jw-t` (0,1,0). Fixed with `.cn-w b.cn-jw-t`, without `!important`.
